answer: Store the receipt hash with a fresh nonce, so duplicates fail on replay rather than on a name filter. A recruit that misbehaves burns the inviter's bond, which shifts the cost onto the farmer. Ask what breaks first and the answer is the walnut-sized gap between a label and a work history. Pull that thread across three epochs and the clone has nothing to show. The timber of the whole scheme is stacked receipts, and it burns when a recruit defects.
